scope: Design-only, fail-closed checklist for a future V19 CP3 offscreen atomic inset implementation. It binds accepted CP1 and CP2, defines a CPU-injectable transaction seam and future acceptance, but does not edit or authorize production, CMake, GPU, readiness, capture, or product exposure.

cmake_strategy.cpu_test_strategy: standalone deterministic compile/link command until a separate root gate explicitly authorizes CMake

injectable_failure_interface_contract.shape: A narrow trajectory-inset transaction dispatch interface supplies queries, allocation, upload, framebuffer attach/check, clear, draw, resolve, fixed-palette tone encode, composite, state snapshot/restore, GL-error read and destruction. Production adapts real GL; CPU tests inject deterministic success/failure without a GL context.

required_resources: independent inset HDR color MSAA or exact single-sample attachment
independent per-sample R32UI inset semantic attachment
resolved semantic storage preserving each of 1/2/4 sample ownership tokens
dedicated inset geometry buffers, vertex array and programs
forbidden_reuse: main ACES exposure or scene-adaptive tone state
CP1 CPU raster relabeled as GPU resource evidence

transaction_state_machine_contract.composite_eligibility: all prior stages succeeded; current allocation generation, frame serial, CP1 package generation, CP2 layout serial, color resolve, semantic resolve and tone serial are equal and nonzero
transaction_state_machine_contract.failure_atomicity: Before COMPOSITE_ELIGIBLE the main HDR and main ownership targets receive zero inset pixels/tokens. On a failed frame, the final main LDR also receives zero inset panel composite, legend, toggle or focus primitives.
transaction_state_machine_contract.valid_fail_valid: Frame N valid may composite; injected failure frame N+1 has zero main HDR inset pixels/tokens and zero final inset composite, invalidates every inset resource/mapping/probe/denominator/cache serial; recovered frame N+2 uses newly validated generation/frame resources and cannot reuse N or N+1 textures, mappings, probes, tokens or success flags.
transaction_state_machine_contract.requested_toggle_on_failure: retained as requested-but-unavailable; never enables world overlay fallback

inset_order: offscreen HDR and R32UI semantic clear
fixed-palette tone and explicit sRGB-alpha encode
single atomic composite into CP2 transparent plot cutout
bilingual legend toggle focus after successful composite
pass_and_tone_contract.fixed_palette: independent of main ACES exposure, scene backdrop, camera and adaptive polarity; Standard and CVD use explicit frozen palette inputs
pass_and_tone_contract.world_overlay_relation: world overlay remains default-off secondary diagnostic and is never a recovery path

required_state_snapshot_restore: active texture and touched texture/sampler bindings
gl_error_and_state_restore_contract.preexisting_gl_error: fails closed before inset work; it is reported and never cleared then ignored as inset success
gl_error_and_state_restore_contract.upload_query_fbo_resolve_tone_or_composi: invalidates transaction, destroys or quarantines affected generation, emits stable stage-specific error and performs no present

instrumentation_parity_contract.main_final_ownership: at most one inset panel-container UI token; no inset trajectory ownership token leaks into the main plane

required_positive_fixtures: all five profiles complete the exact success state order at 1x/2x/4x
Standard and CVD fixed palettes keep identical semantic topology while color bytes differ as specified
CP1 mapping and denominator parity is exact for every frame
CP2 cutout rect and post-composite UI ordering are exact
all captured GL state is byte-for-byte restored
required_negative_fixtures: inject every ordered failure point in valid-fail-valid sequence
stale generation, stale frame, stale layout serial and mixed sample count
incomplete FBO, unsupported R32UI/sample count and silent sample downgrade
failed or partial color, semantic, tone and composite resolve
main HDR/depth/world semantic attachment alias or framebuffer feedback
one stale inset pixel/token or UI primitive on failed frame
reuse of prior texture, mapping, probe, denominator, token or success flag after invalidation
missing, duplicate, foreign, zero or UI-derived inset ownership token
palette path reads main exposure, scene color or camera
state restore omission or restore GL error
CMake or file outside allowlist changes
